item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 11/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The area of low pressure now over Hainan Island will move eastward across the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. Under the influence of the area of low pressure and its associated trough of low pressure, there will be occasional showers and squally thunderstorms over the coast of southern China early this week. The southwest monsoon is expected to become active in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will remain unsettled over the coast of Guangdong. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Guchol will move across the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days.
